close_reason: Design decision recorded — producedAt future-date hard-fail is correct and worth defending.
description: OcspChecker rejects responses with producedAt > now (returns OcspStatusUnknown). A contributor might suggest this is too strict since the response content could still be valid. Correct response: a future-dated producedAt indicates clock skew or a pre-generated response — neither situation should be trusted for revocation status, and hard-fail is the only safe default for a security-sensitive check.
title: OcspChecker producedAt future-date rejection: correct hard-fail
